nativeReference.durabilityFilterUnit: HP / maxHP rounded to a hundredth by Mathf.Round, clamped to 0..1

webDesignChoices: Prioritize a complete shared-policy, physical selection/wear/removal, forced protection and persistence loop before tuning rates.
Reuse seasonal climate for warmth classification if available; room-temperature ranking is a distinct design adaptation.
A fixed deterministic retry interval and tie-breaker differ from native random scan timing and list-order ties.
Immediate rescans after shared filter edits or clear-forced are usability adaptations beyond the directly observed setters.
Rejecting or cancelling an active wear job after policy edits is a Web consistency choice; the native wear driver does not re-evaluate the policy in the bounded method.
Legacy saves defaulting to manual clothing management preserve old Web behavior; this is not a native migration rule.
Preserve the layer/body-part-group conflict graph instead of replacing it with one item per garment category.
DLC wardrobe rules, role/title bonuses, biocoding, clothing sources, taint and special apparel must remain explicit omissions until supported.
